notes.title: Update, finally! (0.0.14 Alpha) | 26th of August 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]New Release! What's new?[/h1]
Quite the procrastinated update I would say.

[h2]⚙ General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Sanity System[/b]: What's the worst that could happen?
[*]Added [b][i]Pessi[/i][/b] so you won't get thirsty in the Backrooms, ever again. Finally! It'll also regenerate a bit of sanity.
[*][b]Level Selector[/b]: Finally.
[*]A new save system, meaning that booting this game version with existent save data from an older version, will result in a Migration screen appearing upon start-up.
[*]You can now skip the Disclaimer screen.
[*]You can now reset save data and choose to reset achievements.
[*]Fixed AI slowing down near player proximity, meaning that the Howler in Level 0 is more.. motivated to chase you.
[*]Added half-baked controller support. Again.
[*]Steam Cloud.
[/list]

[h2]🗺 Map Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Small changes to Steam Audio across all levels.
[h3]Level 0[/h3]
[*]Added ringing phone as a physical object, finding it will result in a small reward.
[h3]Level 1[/h3]
[*]Optimizations.
[h3]Level 4[/h3]
[*]Small layout changes.
[h3]Level 'Before This Game Existed'[/h3]
[*]Replaced cassette audio with another banger of mine.
[/list]

[h2]🎨 UI Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Sanity in the top-left corner.
[*]The control hints will only show up in Level 0.
[*]Fixed a bug in the Graphics Settings UI, not allowing the user to set the Shadow Quality to Low, as it would get reverted back to Medium.
[/list]

[h2]🐞 Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*]Level 1 Out-Of-Bounds Bug
[/list]

notes.title: Nightly Build Update (19th of Novemebr 2023)
notes.notes:
[h2]Nightly Builds have been unlocked. What shiny perks do you get?![/h2]
[list]
[*] Developer Console
[*] Unfinished Stuff
[*] Double the bugs!
[/list]

Well, this was a brief introduction for the new players who want to break the game on their own.

[h1]How do I access Nightly Builds?[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1. [b]Go into your Library and right-click Budget Backrooms, from the context menu click 'Properties'.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44612138/e1af87e644e076a24fa7eaa691df3def8c2114f3.png[/img]

[*] 2. [b]Inside the Properties window, choose the 'Betas' category, and from the drop-down select nightly-dev.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44612138/b779d17c87bd02af6add5203b00ccdfecd395863.png[/img]

[*] 3. [b]Wait for your game to update and you now have access to Nightly Builds.[/b]
[/list]

[u][b][i]Please do not report bugs since they might be fixed anyway.[/i][/b][/u]
